Use only a separate authorized noncontrolled practice issuance with positive outstanding; do not create/reset/issue stock as an implicit replay step.
Compare the approved return amount with the actual remaining quantity; never blindly copy1. Select the permitted destination and accurate condition.

Read the fresh ledger and balances. If uncertain or an error appears, stop and inspect; do not repeat Return, rebuild balances, change database state or infer success.
Do not invoke witness/attestation, controlled stock, repair/work order, provider, import or report/PDF workflows from this lesson.
